final: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) as site_articount FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), stats AS (SELECT SUM(site_articount) as total_artifacts, COUNT(*) as num_sites FROM site_totals), with_shares AS (SELECT st.zoneref, st.site_articount, st.site_articount * 1.0 / stats.total_artifacts as share, 1.0 / stats.num_sites as avg_share, st.site_articount * 1.0 / stats.total_artifacts - 1.0 / stats.num_sites as difference FROM site_totals st, stats WHERE stats.total_artifacts IS NOT NULL AND stats.total_artifacts > 0 AND stats.num_sites IS NOT NULL AND stats.num_sites > 0) SELECT zoneref, site_articount, share, difference FROM with_shares ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
